outcome.Summary: Extended the config package: added `Timeout time.Duration` (env APP_TIMEOUT via time.ParseDuration, default 30s) and `Tags []string` (env APP_TAGS, comma-separated with trimming/empty-item dropping). Added `Merge(base, override Config)` where non-zero override fields replace base's, a non-nil override Tags slice replaces base even if empty, and both slices are copied so arguments are never mutated. Reworked `Load` to collect all invalid env values and return them joined via errors.Join (zero Config on error), preserving existing field behaviour. Added tests covering defaults, overrides, tag parsing, multi-error collection, merge semantics and argument immutability; `go test ./... -count=1` and `go vet` pass.
